title: Two different presets, one country
question: Left is the 'rolling' preset, right is 'terraced' — same seed, same camera, same hour. Is this two different kinds of country, or the same country twice?
context_md:
Measuring why worldgen keeps coming back 'I see no difference'.

A colour-histogram distance over everything below the skyline says these two presets are **closer to each other (0.149) than 'rolling' is to another 'rolling' at a different seed (0.173)**. So on the number, changing the preset moves the picture *less* than changing the seed does.

I want to know whether your eye agrees before a revamp is scoped around it. The companion card ('arid' vs 'wetland') is the control — the same measurement says that pair is 4.8x further apart.
